checked.label: heroRange
problems: Glantz 2020 Table 4: ALD remission all countries combined 59.7; Lebanon 29.0, Iraq 93.9; US, NZ and Mexico have no ALD figure (dash), so '26 surveys, not the US' holds; 2001-2015 and the 12-months-or-two-birthdays definition confirmed.

Rapsey 2019 abstract: 67.2% of dependence cases remitted, 12,992 people, Oct 2003-Dec 2004 confirmed; the '12 months' definition quote is not in the abstract (agent cites the article page), not re-confirmed here.

Range line is not more hopeful than the hero: 60/67 sit between the 42 head count and the 91 projection, and the line says why (looser definition). Iraq's 94 rests on a tiny sample (SE 5.2), fine in the fold.
Optional: Rapsey's abstract also gives '50% of dependence cases had not remitted after 9 years' in New Zealand, a second half-free figure (9 vs 14 years) for the fold if wanted.
